steps.answer: It leaves room for the house to extend to the right.

steps.title: Add a triangular roof
steps.instruction: Type the changed lines, then press Run. Keep the rest of your working code.
steps.explain: Move up the left wall with the pen lifted. A 60-degree start aims the first roof edge upward.
steps.expected: A triangle sitting on top of the square.
steps.question: Why lift the pen when moving up the wall?
steps.answer: It keeps that move from drawing over the wall in a new color.

steps.explain: The roof is its own closed shape, so it needs its own fill pair.
steps.expected: A coral roof above the blue house.
steps.question: What would happen if the last roof edge were missing?
steps.answer: The fill would close the shape, but the outline would be missing that edge.

steps.title: Put in the doorway
steps.instruction: Type the changed lines, then press Run. Keep the rest of your working code.
steps.explain: From the roof’s left corner, move down and then along the bottom wall. A rectangle alternates two side lengths.
steps.expected: A dark door centered in the house.
steps.question: Why does this rectangle loop repeat twice?
steps.answer: Each repeat draws a width and a height; two repeats make four sides.
